ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Long Shade
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
LONGSHADE_RM_MOD_BUILD_1, Phase A row 2 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md (parent BIOME_MOD_SPLIT_EXECUTION_1, governed by BIOME_PAINT_ONCE_AT_THE_END_1). The Long Shade — RM_LongShade — is a dayside desert band at a sun so low every stone throws a shadow four times its own height: nothing lives in the light and nothing survives leaving shelter, so life here is a sprint between islands of shade. Name ruled 2026-09-21 (biome_mod_architecture.md §7 Q2, the owner's own recommended row): "the Long Shade", off `RUT_Desert`'s sheet identity, design/Jawa/worldbuilding/ biomes/desert.md (FROZEN, BIOME_FREEZE_FABLE_REVIEW_1).
RM tier: this def names no other franchise or campaign and is playable standalone on any generated RimWorld planet, terrain + two native creatures + native flora only. It ships its own native wild fauna (JOE_Landopus, JOE_Cephalope — absorbed non-Star-Wars donor fauna, own defs) and native flora (RM_Vorrel, the desert's cycle plant, moved and renamed here from mandrake.rut.ashkarrflora per §7 Q8 — working name, see RM_Vorrel.xml's own header). RM_Leachmoss and RM_Venomvine (mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards, MayRequire-guarded) and RSW_Ultracactus and five more Star Wars-tier wild plants (mandrake.rsw.swbestiary, MayRequire-guarded) stay wired inline at their existing weights, same shape as every other RimMandrake biome mod's still-open wildPlants MayRequire gap (§7, item 4 — no WildPlants_<Biome>.xml patch route exists anywhere yet).
Every `RSW_`/`SW_`-tier and campaign-tier creature (51 rows) is OUT of this def by design (§7 Q11/Q12: RimMandrake never names Star Wars) and rides src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Patches/WildAnimals_LongShade.xml as a PatchOperationAdd onto RM_LongShade, MayRequire="mandrake.rsw.swbestiary" — this mod alone, with nothing else loaded, keeps its own two native predators plus whatever the Mod Settings screen leaves enabled from the shared shade-grid / contact-venom kits (mandrake.rm.creaturebehaviors, mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards — loadAfter only, no hard dependency; both already ship their own global toggles for those mechanics, so this mod adds no duplicate gate).
The `RUT_Desert` twin in mandrake.rut.patches is FROZEN, not deleted — it carries the player's saved campaign world until the terminal paint (BIOME_PAINT_ONCE_AT_THE_END_1). Every content fix for the Long Shade lands here from now on.
